conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with an expected ~1.5%/month return. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting an expected ~2.5%/month return. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, balancing growth with risk management.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets an expected ~4%/month return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk.
